title: híd, folyó, Duna: The River and the Bridge

sections.title: Budapest sits on a river
sections.content: híd ("bridge"), folyó ("river") and part ("shore, bank") describe the geography around you — and Duna ("the Danube") is the folyó that runs through Budapest. mellett ("next to"), from A1, works naturally with all of them.

items.english: The Danube is a big river.
We like walking beside the river.

sections.content: Szép a folyó partja reuses the 3rd-person possessive -a/-e/-ja/-je from Unit 3 — partja is "its bank", built exactly the way apja was "his father".
